missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Партия' stays in the nominative case as the subject that won. 'Эта' is the agreeing feminine demonstrative, and 'на выборах' gives the prepositional setting of the victory.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Партию' is the accusative direct object of 'поддерживаю'. 'Эту' agrees in the feminine accusative, and the negation expresses political distance.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Партии' is the genitive form after 'лидером', showing leadership of the party. 'Большой' is the agreeing feminine genitive adjective.

missions.phrase: Журналисты много пишут об этой партии.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об этой партии' uses the prepositional form 'партии' after 'об' to express writing about something. 'Этой' is the agreeing feminine prepositional demonstrative.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Партии' is the dative form, the recipient of the vote. 'Голос' stays accusative as the object given, and 'свой' marks it as his own.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Партией' is the instrumental form required by 'управляет', the verb of governing. 'Давно' adds the long duration of his control.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Партий' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Разных' is the agreeing genitive plural adjective, and 'в стране' gives the setting.

missions.phrase: Эти партии часто спорят между собой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Партии' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'спорят'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'между собой' shows mutual conflict.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Партию' is accusative after 'в' with the motion verb 'вступил', expressing joining. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Партии' is the genitive form showing whose programme it is. 'Программа' stays nominative as the subject, described by 'понятная'.
